description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse and goading it.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
